excluded_future_courses.title: Design and build integrated AI agent solutions in Copilot Studio

courses.title: Build a foundation to build AI agents and extend Microsoft 365 Copilot
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course introducing AI agents, Microsoft 365 Copilot extension options, and low-code versus pro-code development paths.
courses.long_description: This Microsoft Learn course helps learners compare Microsoft agent development options including Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit, then choose an appropriate development path.

courses.title: Develop AI agents on Azure
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course on creating, deploying, and managing intelligent AI agents with Azure AI Foundry.
courses.long_description: This course teaches developers, data scientists, and IT professionals how to integrate advanced AI capabilities into scalable agent-based Azure solutions.

courses.title: Implement Generative AI engineering with Azure Databricks
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course on building generative AI applications with Azure Databricks, Spark, RAG, model tuning, and LLMOps.
courses.long_description: This course covers generative AI engineering on Azure Databricks, including retrieval-augmented generation, multi-stage reasoning, model fine-tuning, evaluation, responsible AI, and production model operations.

courses.title: Operationalize machine learning and generative AI solutions
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course on MLOps and GenAIOps for secure, scalable AI solutions on Azure.
courses.long_description: This course prepares learners to design, implement, and operate MLOps and GenAIOps solutions on Azure, including infrastructure, model lifecycle management, automation, CI/CD, observability, and generative AI application operations.

courses.title: Introduction to AI in Azure
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course introducing AI concepts and Azure services used to create AI solutions.
courses.long_description: This course introduces foundational artificial intelligence concepts and the Microsoft Azure services used to build AI solutions, with recommended background in Python and core cloud concepts.

courses.title: Develop AI cloud solutions on Azure
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course on building secure, observable, AI-driven cloud applications on Azure.
courses.long_description: This course teaches developers how to create, monitor, and troubleshoot AI solutions on Azure using compute, containers, serverless APIs, event-driven integration, and data services that support AI workloads.

courses.title: Develop AI apps and agents on Azure
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course for software developers building AI apps and agents with Microsoft Foundry.
courses.long_description: This course covers developing generative AI apps, building AI agents, implementing knowledge connections and tools, and working with multimodal capabilities in Microsoft Foundry.

courses.title: Extract insights from visual data on Azure
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course on building applications that reason over images and documents using multimodal models and agent tools.
courses.long_description: This course focuses on visual and document AI workflows, including structured extraction, analysis, tool orchestration, and grounding model responses in visual data.

courses.title: Develop AI-enabled database solutions
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course on designing and developing AI-enabled database solutions across Microsoft SQL platforms.
courses.long_description: This course covers modern data solutions that integrate structured and semi-structured data with AI features, including SQL Server, Azure SQL, SQL databases in Microsoft Fabric, vector search, and embeddings.

courses.title: Implement a data science and machine learning solution for AI with Microsoft Fabric
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course on implementing data science and machine learning solutions with Microsoft Fabric.
courses.long_description: This course covers the end-to-end data science process in Microsoft Fabric, including data exploration, preparation, model training, evaluation, tracking, deployment, and prediction generation.

courses.title: Extend Microsoft 365 Copilot in Copilot Studio
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course on building low-code declarative agents that extend Microsoft 365 Copilot using Copilot Studio.
courses.long_description: This course guides learners through creating Copilot Studio agents, configuring custom knowledge and conversational instructions, setting up tools, and publishing agents to Microsoft 365 Copilot environments.

courses.title: Introduction to Microsoft 365 and AI administration
courses.brief: A Microsoft Learn course introducing Microsoft 365 administration, Copilot, and AI-powered agents.
courses.long_description: This course introduces Microsoft 365 services, administrative controls, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and AI-powered agents for beginning technical IT professionals and novice administrators.
